Definition: from G4253 and G4198; to precede (as guide or herald):--go before.
BiblicalUsage: Proporeuomai means to go before, to precede as a guide or herald. The angel promises that John's child shall go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways, and Stephen reminds the rulers that their fathers said, make us gods to go before us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe going before is the herald's calling, and the herald who prepares the way must decrease as the King appears.
